provenance.l: Hayabusa2 — first touchdown on Ryugu 22:29 UTC 21 Feb 2019: descent from 20 km, the final sequence from the 45 m checkpoint took 22 min (58 planned), tantalum bullet at ~300 m/s, 1 m from the centre of a 6 m site (Planetary Society). The model flies the last 45 m; speeds are estimates
